S: Runway crudités with whipped feta and dill
the Runway office, where nobody admits to eating

Baby carrots, snow peas, radishes and cucumber spears around a whipped feta, lemon and dill dip finished with olive oil and chilli flakes. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt, the zest and juice of half a lemon and 2 tbsp olive oil until smooth. Stir through 2 tbsp chopped dill. Spread into a shallow bowl, drizzle with more oil and scatter with chilli flakes. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots, 150g snow peas and 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 continental cucumber into spears, and stand everything in ice water for 10 minutes to crisp up. Drain well and arrange neatly around the dip.

M: Seared sirloin basted in garlic butter, creamed spinach, roast potatoes
Sirloin steak seared hard in a smoking pan, butter basted, rested and sliced, with creamed spinach and crispy potatoes.
Nate's birthday, the one Andy misses for work

Chicken thighs browned in butter, braised with white wine and leeks, finished with cream and fresh tarragon, with crusty baguette to mop the sauce. Season 8 skin-on chicken thighs and brown skin side down in a large pan with 20g butter over medium heat for 8 minutes. Turn and remove. Soften 2 sliced leeks and 2 garlic cloves in the fat for 5 minutes. Add 200ml white wine and boil 2 minutes, then 250ml chicken stock. Return the chicken skin side up, cover and simmer 25 minutes. Stir 150ml cream and 2 tbsp chopped tarragon into the sauce and bubble 3 minutes. Serve with warm baguette.
W: Sweet pastry case with vanilla custard and blueberries, apricot glaze
Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with vanilla custard and topped with blueberries brushed with warm apricot glaze.
K: Vodka, coffee liqueur and espresso shaken over ice

Freshly pulled espresso shaken hard with vodka, coffee liqueur and a touch of sugar syrup, strained into chilled coupes under a thick crema with three coffee beans. Chill 4 coupe glasses in the freezer. Pull 4 shots of espresso, about 120ml, and let them cool for 5 minutes. For each drink, fill a shaker with ice and add 45ml vodka, 30ml coffee liqueur, 30ml espresso and 10ml sugar syrup. Shake as hard as you can for 15 seconds so it foams. Strain into a chilled coupe and float 3 coffee beans on the crema. Serve straight away, on time.

s.note: Sourdough toasted with gruyere and cheddar
s.how: Butter thick slices of sourdough on the outside. Fill with grated gruyere and cheddar. Cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into fingers and serve to anyone who has just come home very late from work.

s.note: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, figs with goat's cheese and honey
s.how: Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and snipped chives. Halve 6 fresh figs, top each with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey. Arrange both in neat rows on a white platter, as sharp as a front row seat.

m.note: Seared sirloin basted in garlic butter, creamed spinach, roast potatoes
m.how: Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloin steaks in a smoking pan, baste with butter and garlic and rest. Wilt 300g spinach and simmer with 150ml cream until thick. Serve sliced, exactly when expected. That's all.

w.note: Sweet pastry case with vanilla custard and blueberries, apricot glaze
w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case and cool. Fill with 500ml thick custard and pile 250g blueberries on top. Warm apricot jam with a splash of water and brush over to glaze. Dust the edge with icing sugar. The colour was chosen for you years ago.
